outcome: Regional oxygen saturation (rSO2) of the brain, preductal and postductal tissues
Dynamics of rSO2 during postnatal transition
cohort: 51 preterm infants (≥ 30 + 0 and < 37 + 0 weeks) delivered by caesarean section
finding: Preterm infants requiring respiratory support exhibit lower regional oxygen saturation levels compared to those with normal transition, suggesting compromised perfusion in addition to lower arterial oxygen saturation.
